projects.name: Signal Point
projects.title: Signal Point: Concrete Fire Pit, East Austin | Red Agave
projects.desc: East Austin backyard by Red Agave, built in 2018: a poured concrete fire pit on a steel-framed gravel court, with a steel trellis carrying jasmine.
projects.headline: Signal Point: Poured Concrete Fire Pit, Steel Court and Jasmine Trellis in East Austin, TX
projects.schema_desc: A custom formed and poured concrete fire pit on a raised gravel court framed in steel, with a steel trellis that wraps around the seating and carries jasmine. Built in East Austin in 2018. Designed and built by Red Agave Landscape.
projects.h2: A poured concrete fire pit, a steel court, and jasmine on the trellis.
paras: Red Agave Landscape designed and built this backyard fire court on Signal Point in East Austin in 2018. The fire pit is concrete, custom formed, framed and poured for this yard. It sits on a raised court of dark gravel framed in steel, and a steel trellis wraps around the seating and carries jasmine.

The lines of the form boards show on the faces of the fire pit. The steel frame holds the gravel above the lawn, and a second, lower steel frame makes the step up from the grass. The trellis is steel posts and rails with wire grid panels. It runs along two sides of the court, and the jasmine climbs the panels behind the seating.

hero.alt: Square poured concrete fire pit on a raised court of dark gravel framed in steel, with a steel and wire trellis carrying jasmine behind the seating, in East Austin

figs.alt: Poured concrete fire pit showing the lines of its form boards, on a steel-framed gravel court with a lower steel-framed step at the lawn, in East Austin
Steel trellis with wire grid panels and jasmine at the corner of a steel-framed gravel court, with the concrete fire pit behind it, in East Austin

items: Form board lines left in the faces
Lower steel-framed step at the lawn
Wraps two sides of the court

faqs: What is the fire pit made of?
Poured concrete. Red Agave formed and framed it for this yard, and the lines of the form boards show on its faces.
What holds the gravel court?
Steel. The court is a raised bed of dark gravel framed in steel, with a second, lower steel frame as the step up from the lawn.
What grows on the trellis?
Jasmine. The trellis is steel with wire grid panels, and it wraps around two sides of the seating area.
Who built it, and when?
Red Agave Landscape built it in 2018, with our own crew. Every project starts with a free consultation, and the CAD plan is included.

projects.headline: Williston Loop: Limestone Pavers, Three Gravels and a Chop Block Fire Pit in South Austin, TX
projects.schema_desc: Welded steel dividing beds of basalt gravel, pea gravel and limestone gravel, with two-by-four-foot limestone pavers, a limestone chop block fire pit, a wood deck, dioon, clumping bamboo and artichoke agave. Built in South Austin in 2018. Designed and built by Red Agave Landscape.
projects.kicker: Limestone · Welded Steel · Basalt · Pea Gravel
projects.h2: Three gravels, limestone pavers, and a chop block fire pit, held by welded steel.
paras: Red Agave Landscape designed and built this back yard and side yard on Williston Loop in South Austin in 2018. Welded steel divides the ground into beds of basalt gravel, pea gravel and limestone gravel. Limestone pavers, each two feet by four feet, run down the side yard to a wood deck and a limestone chop block fire pit.

The pavers sit in pea gravel inside a raised steel frame. Limestone gravel fills the paths beside them, and the fire pit stands on a square of basalt gravel. The planting is dioon, clumping bamboo and artichoke agave. The dioons grow in pea gravel beds along the fence, and the bamboo grows along the back fence.

figs.cap_b: Limestone in pea gravel / welded steel

figs.alt: Limestone chop block fire pit with limestone caps on basalt gravel, looking back along the paver path, with two dioons in pea gravel along the fence, in South Austin
Dioon planted in pea gravel beside a limestone gravel path, with the chop block fire pit on basalt gravel and the deck steps behind, in South Austin
Limestone gravel beside a raised steel-framed bed of pea gravel and limestone pavers, leading to the wood deck steps and the fire pit, in South Austin

items: Limestone caps on the fire pit
Raised steel frame around the paver path

faqs: What are the three gravels?
Basalt gravel around the fire pit, pea gravel around the pavers and in the planting beds, and limestone gravel on the paths. Welded steel keeps each one in its own bed.
What is a chop block fire pit?
A fire pit built from limestone chop block, which is limestone cut into blocks with a rough face. This one is square, with limestone caps.
What size are the limestone pavers?
Two feet by four feet. They are set in pea gravel inside a raised welded steel frame.
What is planted in this yard?
Dioon, clumping bamboo and artichoke agave.
Who built it, and when?
Red Agave Landscape built it in 2018, with our own crew. Every project starts with a free consultation, and the CAD plan is included.

projects.headline: Strass Drive: Oversized Concrete Pavers, Basalt, Marble Gravel and Steel Planters in Central Austin, TX
projects.schema_desc: A front walk of oversized poured concrete pavers with basalt gravel joints, white marble gravel, welded quarter-inch steel edging and square steel planters, sky pencil holly and barrel cacti. Built in Central Austin in 2018. Designed and built by Red Agave Landscape.
projects.kicker: Poured Concrete · Quarter-Inch Steel · Basalt · Marble
projects.h2: Oversized concrete pavers, black basalt, white marble, and quarter-inch steel.
paras: Red Agave Landscape designed and built this front yard on Strass Drive in Central Austin in 2018. Oversized pavers of poured concrete lead from the street to the front door, with basalt gravel in the joints. Welded quarter-inch steel frames the walk and keeps the black basalt apart from the white marble gravel.

Three square steel planters sit in the marble gravel. Each one is filled with basalt and holds a barrel cactus. A long steel planter runs along the front wall of the house, planted with sky pencil holly. More barrel cacti grow in the basalt bed at the curb.

hero.alt: Oversized poured concrete pavers with basalt gravel joints leading to a front door, beside square steel planters holding barrel cacti in white marble gravel, in Central Austin

figs.alt: Three square welded steel planters filled with basalt, each holding a barrel cactus, set in white marble gravel, with sky pencil holly along the front wall of the house, in Central Austin
Front walk of oversized poured concrete pavers framed in welded steel, with basalt gravel in the joints and white marble gravel on both sides, in Central Austin

items: Runs from the curb to the front door
Long steel planter along the house

faqs: What are the pavers made of?
Poured concrete. They are oversized pavers, with basalt gravel in the joints, and they run from the curb to the front door.
How thick is the steel?
A quarter inch. The edging and the planters are welded quarter-inch steel.
What are the white and black gravels?
The white gravel is marble and the black gravel is basalt. Welded steel keeps the two apart.
What is planted in this yard?
Sky pencil holly along the front wall of the house, and barrel cacti in the steel planters and the basalt beds.
Who built it, and when?
Red Agave Landscape built it in 2018, with our own crew. Every project starts with a free consultation, and the CAD plan is included.
